findings.title: Two visible dark accent text consumers fail normal-text AA contrast
findings.normativeBasis: STYLE_GUIDE section 9 requires WCAG 2.2 AA. Task criterion 4 explicitly forbids accepted visual variance from waiving accessibility or interaction contracts. These are ordinary visible text and an enabled keyboard link, not disabled content or a decorative logo.
